counterfactual_missing_items: C1 does not itself quote the right breast cancer history, though parent R3 supplies it
C1 does not quote the mastectomy scar location on the right anterior chest wall
decisive_items: Multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels
pruritic erythema lesion with multiple nodules
response.rationale: C1 is the more complete and specific diagnosis: it shares the biopsy-proven dermal lymphatic carcinomatosis with R3 and adds the erysipelatoides-defining morphology (pruritic erythema with nodules and a well-demarcated warm erythematous plaque). R3 is correct but under-specified as generic cutaneous metastasis and does not capture the subtype.
